title: module.yml
description: The metadata of one kit module, modules/<name>/module.yml. Each key is described in docs/modules.md.

description.description: One line, shown by kit module list.

default.description: When true, the module is active unless removed. kit install activates every default module.

items.description: The name of another module in the release, activated with this one.

^[a-z_]+$.description: The default value of a template key, written @key@ in the module's templates.

expects.description: Lines the module expects in files the repository owns, such as the line that includes a delivered file (extends: [.kit/lefthook.yml]). kit check reports each missing line with its remedy. The kit never writes these lines.

path.description: The file, relative to the repository root.

pattern.description: An extended regular expression some line of the file must match.

remedy.description: What to add, and why, printed when no line matches.
